text: Besides weather type, such as hail, freezing raining, and thunderstorm, weather radar reports include observation time, weather intensity in terms of light, moderate, heavy, and extreme, as well as intensity trend, increasing, decreasing, or no change. It may also contain weather movement direction and speed, and the heights of tops in hundreds or thousands of feet. Question. What is the intensity of precipitation in the radar report?
